rationale: Re-reviewed compiler-convert after the second #544 review round and the dev merge (convert-to-jess.ts, sandbox-route.ts, index.ts, convert-to-jess.test.ts). printConversion still takes each converted document's projection only from context.pluginOf(document)?.jessFunctions?.() and passes it unchanged as emitJess's functions option; no #less/#sass projection is built in the consumer and the owner is not imported. New code is consumer-owned: claimTargets decides which documents may write their .jess path (existing file without overwrite, symlink, same dev+ino as a loaded file), convertToJess takes { overwrite }, and the engine-result check returns paths as the render spelled them, using realpath only for containment. The alternatives' anchor lines are unchanged.
